hero.subheadline: Private boat tours crafted for those who seek the extraordinary

how.title: Three Steps to an Unforgettable Day
how.subtitle: From first inquiry to setting sail — we take care of everything

steps.title: Choose Your Experience
steps.desc: Browse our curated collection of private tours — from a golden hour aperitivo to a full-day journey along Como's most iconic shores.

steps.title: Select Your Date
steps.desc: Pick the perfect day and time. Our team will confirm availability and tailor every detail to your preferences.

steps.title: Sail & Celebrate
steps.desc: Come aboard, leave everything else behind, and let the beauty of Lake Como unfold around you.

boats.name: Bruno Abbate Primatist 25
boats.desc: An icon of Italian design. Sporty and agile, with lines that cut through the water with grace — the perfect vessel for those who want to experience the lake in a dynamic and unforgettable way.

boats.name: Cranchi Turchese 24
boats.desc: Class and comfort without compromise. Generous spaces and timeless elegance make her the perfect choice for those seeking relaxation and refinement on the lake.

packages.title: Curated Moments on Lake Como
packages.subtitle: Every journey is private. Every detail, considered.

items.name: Golden Hour
items.desc: Toast to the sunset with a glass of Prosecco as Como's golden light paints the water. The perfect one-hour escape.

items.name: Breakfast on Board
items.desc: Begin your day with a curated lakeside breakfast, drifting through Como's morning calm. Available 8:30–10:30.
items.includes: Full breakfast service · Scenic morning tour

items.name: Aperitivo Tour
items.desc: The Italian art of the aperitivo, elevated at sunset on the lake. Drift past the most iconic shores as the sky turns gold.
items.includes: Italian aperitivo & stuzzichini · Drinks at sunset

items.name: Sushi Experience
items.desc: Premium sushi box and curated drinks on a scenic panoramic cruise through Como's most breathtaking views.
items.includes: Premium sushi box · Curated drinks · Panoramic route

items.name: Como Luxury
items.desc: Villa Pliniana, Villa Oleandra (George Clooney's estate), Nesso — Como's most exclusive landmarks, seen from the water.
items.includes: Villa Pliniana · Villa Oleandra · Nesso gorge

items.name: La Dolce Vita
items.desc: A grand journey to Isola Comacina and the jewel village of Varenna — the definitive, unforgettable Como experience.
items.includes: Isola Comacina · Varenna · Full lake grand tour

sections.title: Where the Alps Meet the Water
sections.desc: Lake Como has enchanted artists, royalty, and wanderers for centuries. Seen from the water, its magic is unrivalled.

sections.title: Villas, Gardens & Timeless Beauty
sections.desc: Glide past centuries-old villas, hidden gardens, and sun-drenched terraces that define the Como way of life.

sections.title: A Private World on the Water
sections.desc: No crowds. No fixed itineraries. Just you, the lake, and an experience crafted entirely around your wishes.

location.title: This Is Where We Meet
location.subtitle: Your Lake Como journey begins on the lakefront. Easy to find, impossible to forget.
location.dock_desc: The dock is located at the very beginning of Lungo Lario Trieste avenue. We'll be there waiting to welcome you aboard.
location.directions: Head to the Como lakefront and follow Lungo Lario Trieste. Our dock is visible right at the start of the avenue, on the water's edge.

contact.title: We're Here for You
contact.subtitle: From general questions to last-minute requests — our team is always available.
